description: The case of the Codex review of the commit that compared config names without case and always watched vite configs: `it` imported from support.js, which re-exports vitest's. `it.skipIf(false)` → `it.skipIf(true)` skips a test that ran with an unchanged marker count, so no net sees it. An import from another module is not a static import of a runner: TG003 itself warns.
